testcase.name: WHEN assembling More THEN use the captured header even if the provider advances
WHEN a provider offers an item THEN show it in the section it is configured in
GIVEN toolbar is expended WHEN building default layout THEN navigation block appears at the bottom
WHEN one of the items another expands to changes THEN rebuild the menu with it
WHEN building the default menu THEN keep the sections in the configured order
GIVEN a section is configured as a list WHEN building the menu THEN show its items in a list
GIVEN a section is configured as a grid WHEN building the menu THEN show its items in a grid
GIVEN a section is configured as sticky WHEN building the menu THEN keep it sticky
GIVEN the expanding item itself is not offered WHEN building the menu THEN don't show it
GIVEN its provider cannot configure what it expands to WHEN building the menu THEN don't show it
GIVEN toolbar is at bottom WHEN building default layout THEN navigation block appears at the bottom
GIVEN a provider offers no items WHEN building the menu THEN don't show the section it would be in
GIVEN toolbar is at top WHEN building default layout THEN navigation block appears at the top
WHEN an item changes THEN rebuild the menu with it
WHEN building any default menu THEN it has no report broken site item
GIVEN an item expanding to others WHEN building the menu THEN show inside it what their providers offer
GIVEN nothing is offered for what it expands to WHEN building the menu THEN don't show the item
WHEN only the header changes THEN rebuild the expandable item
